integrity: Exact-rational finite face census and KKT witnesses are reproducible with a standalone checker. Dimension-uniform lower bounds are analytic. Priority is provisional pending independent literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: Sharp coefficients proved only for 2 <= n <= 10; no exact n >= 11 values, no universal upper bound two, and no exact asymptotic limit. Equal-weight equally spaced real convex sequences only.
title: Four-point onset and asymptotic near-doubling of variation sensitivity in convex regression
